        [marketing-media-split kind=media-start orientation=horizontal size=large align=center media=true divided=true fill=canvas aria-label='DNSSEC and cryptographic authentication']
          h2 "DNSSEC and cryptographic authentication"
          p "Protect against DNS spoofing, poisoning, and hijacking with DNSSEC digital signatures backed by automatic Chain of Trust validation for every DNS response."
          img "Diagram: a resolver protected by DNSSEC accepts the signed answer from Edge DNS and rejects forged answers from attackers, backed by a chain of trust from the root to .com to example.com"
        [marketing-media-split kind=media-end orientation=horizontal size=large align=center media=true divided=true fill=canvas aria-label='Native DDoS protection and threat detection']
          h2 "Native DDoS protection and threat detection"
          p "Stop DNS flood attacks, amplification attempts, and malicious queries automatically. Every query is analyzed and rate-limited in real time, no configuration needed."
          img "DDoS Protection filtering traffic before it reaches Edge DNS nameservers on the Azion platform"
        [marketing-media-split kind=media-start orientation=horizontal size=large align=center media=true divided=true fill=canvas aria-label='Split traffic with weighted policies']
          h2 "Split traffic with weighted policies"
          p "Give records with the same name and type a weight from 0 to 255 to set the share of queries each one answers. Shift traffic between origins gradually, or set a weight to 0 to take a record out of rotation without deleting it."
          img "Weighted policy splitting queries for www.example.com across three A records at 60%, 40%, and a disabled record at 0%"
        [marketing-media-split kind=media-end orientation=horizontal size=large align=center media=true divided=true fill=canvas aria-label='Point your apex domain to Azion']
          h2 "Point your apex domain to Azion"
          p "Use ANAME records for CNAME-like behavior on the root domain, so example.com can point straight to an Azion application. MX and TXT records keep working on the same name."
          img "Zone for example.com with an ANAME record at the apex alongside MX and TXT records, resolving to an Azion application"
